tasks.label: sunucu (node server.js)
tasks.command: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8123 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { 'sunucu zaten 8123 portunda calisiyor' } else { node server.js }

tasks.label: sunucuyu durdur (8123)
tasks.command: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8123 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force; 'Durduruldu' } else { 'Zaten kapali' }
